title: Impresso content-item identifier
description: Canonical identifier of an Impresso content item. The preferred property name for this value in Impresso schemas is `ci_id`, although other property names may be used in specific contexts. The identifier has the normative form `<media-id>-<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>-<edition>-i<sequence>`, where `<media-id>` identifies the media source, `<YYYY>-<MM>-<DD>` is the publication date, `<edition>` identifies the edition for that date, and `<sequence>` is the four-digit content-item sequence number within the edition. This schema defines the identifier value independently of the property name under which it is stored.
